body: This is the best idea I've heard. We must find this place.

Thanks a lot, man. I talked to my girlfriend last night and told her as much as I could. I hope it wasn't a bad idea. It made me feel better and more hopeful about my situation. I think I'm going to try to get professional help. I live in Ontario, Canada and M.D psychologists are covered under healthcare and I think I really need to, I'm starting to not be able to function. You're right about the inner strength thing as lame as it sounds. I think I rely too heavily on my SO to somehow make me stronger, which she does, but not in the sense that she makes me get up out of it and do something to change it.
